family.title: Reading routes through archived rune layouts
family.question: Do predefined layout traversal rules recover explicitly specified openings without changing rune values?

scope.representation: Keep every recognized rune including headings, grouped by archived source line. Ignore non-rune characters and lines with no runes. Retain original line and within-line rune positions. LP2-50 is retained as a zero-rune page, with no candidate routes. Left-align rune rows by within-row ordinal. Unequal row lengths remain unequal. Missing cells are skipped, not padded. Ordinal columns are not asserted to be physical image columns.
scope.procedure: Enumerate row-first and column-first routes, both outer directions, both initial inner directions, and constant/alternating inner direction. Preserve every source position and compare the first 12 output indices with nine fixed known openings.
scope.parameters: 16 route configurations per nonempty page; 55 nonempty pages; 880 cases; 7920 exact opening comparisons. No substitution or later-position search.
scope.exclusions: Arbitrary column permutations, spiral paths, rectangular reflow, physical x-coordinate alignment, heading removal, substitution, alternative openings and other text regions.
